issues.sym: A whine that rises with engine speed, a rattle at start-up, low oil pressure warnings, misfires or a drivetrain malfunction message.
issues.why: The plastic guides for the timing chain turn brittle and break. Pieces fall into the oil pan and the chain can jump, wrecking the engine. BMW revised the parts in 2015 and a class action extended coverage on early engines.
issues.next: Stop driving if you hear a new whine or rattle and have the chain and guides inspected. Ask a dealer whether the settlement coverage applies to your VIN.

issues.t: Coolant pump connector can short and start a fire (recall)
issues.sym: Often nothing. Possibly a burning smell, smoke from under the hood or a coolant pump fault.
issues.why: The plug on the electric water pump may not be sealed. Moisture can get in and cause a short circuit, even when parked.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 24V-608 and have it done free. Park outside until the repair is complete.

issues.t: Crankcase vent valve heater can short and start a fire (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning. Possibly a burning plastic smell or smoke from the engine bay, even with the car parked.
issues.why: A small heater on the crankcase ventilation valve can short circuit and melt nearby parts.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 17V-683 and have the heater replaced free. Park outside until then.

issues.t: Passenger seat sensor mat cracks and turns the airbag off
issues.sym: The airbag warning light or the passenger airbag off light stays on with an adult in the seat.
issues.why: The sensing mat inside the front passenger seat cushion can crack from people getting in and out, so the car no longer detects a passenger.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recalls 08V-384 and 17V-605 and have the mat replaced. Until then, the passenger airbag may not work in a crash.

issues.t: Transfer case and its actuator motor wear out
issues.sym: Whining or grinding from under the middle of the car, jerking or binding in tight turns, and 4x4, ABS and brake warning lights together.
issues.why: The small motor that controls the all-wheel-drive clutch has a plastic gear that wears, and the transfer case chain and clutch can wear too, especially with mismatched tires or old fluid.
issues.next: Have the fault codes read soon. Often only the actuator motor or its gear needs replacing if caught early. Keep all four tires matched.

issues.t: Oil leaks from the oil filter housing and valve cover gaskets
issues.sym: Burning oil smell, oil on the front or side of the engine, drips on the ground and low oil messages.
issues.why: The rubber gaskets harden with heat. A leaking filter housing gasket can also soak the drive belt in oil, and a slipping belt can get pulled into the engine.
issues.next: Have leaks fixed soon, especially at the oil filter housing, and replace an oil-soaked belt at the same time.

issues.t: Electric water pump or thermostat fails
issues.sym: Temperature warning, cooling fan running flat out, reduced power or a check engine light for the thermostat.
issues.why: The electric coolant pump can stop without warning, and the electronically controlled thermostat is a frequent failure too.
issues.next: Pull over and switch off if the red temperature warning shows. Have the pump and thermostat replaced together.

issues.t: Coolant leaks from the expansion tank, hoses and plastic fittings
issues.sym: Low coolant warning, a sweet smell, or pink or blue drips under the front of the car.
issues.why: Plastic cooling parts such as the expansion tank and hose connectors get brittle with heat cycles and crack.
issues.next: Top up with the correct coolant and have the system pressure-tested soon. Do not drive it if the temperature warning comes on.

issues.t: Driver airbag inflator may be defective (recall)
issues.sym: No warning signs. The defect only matters if the airbag deploys in a crash.
issues.why: A manufacturing fault in some driver airbag inflators can make them burst when the airbag fires.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recalls 16V-683 and 23V-797 and have the driver airbag replaced free as soon as possible.

issues.t: Front swivel bearings may not be hardened properly (recall)
issues.sym: Possibly no warning, or clunking and loose, wandering steering from the front end.
issues.why: Some front swivel bearings (the knuckles that carry the front wheels) skipped proper heat treatment and can break.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 19V-678 and have the parts replaced free before driving much further.

issues.sym: Brake warning light, a soft or longer pedal, or fluid near a rear wheel.
issues.why: Rear brake hoses on some new-generation X3s can leak, cutting rear braking and disabling ABS and stability control.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 25V-154 and have the hoses replaced free. Do not drive with a brake warning or a soft pedal.
